H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H2123: fulness of the breast; also a moving creature
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not

H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman

H5088: a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised

H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:

H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H4148: properly, chastisement; figuratively, reproof, warning or instruction; also restraint
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)

H7521: to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy adebt
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)

H2506: properly, smoothness (of the tongue); also an allotment
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)

H6775: to link, i.e. gird; figuratively, to serve, (mentally) contrive
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry

H517: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1819: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider

H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H6435: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
H2963: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
